1) the graph connectivity measure based on the number of shortest paths from the node of interest to all other nodes in the graph is the best for WSD, 2) the connectivity measure based on shortest paths is robust with respect to the lexicon used, 3) a lexicon that includes all senses of a word in the training set performs best for WSD.
(1) a graph-based approach to WSD can be effective; and (2) a graph measure called ¿edge connectivity¿ is the best measure for WSD, and it can be used with a variety of different lexicons.

(1) graph-based algorithms for WSD are competitive with state-of-the-art algorithms, and (2) the best graph-based algorithm is the one that uses the largest possible lexicon, which includes the most senses, and that uses a connectivity measure that favors the most connected nodes.
